Subject: HIPAA / BAA eligibility and PHI handling follow-up

Hi Jane great to meet today, and thanks for the detailed walkthrough of MedAI's use case. Quick written recap and next steps to keep things moving on our side.

Recap from today's call:
- MedAI will be sending PHI to the inference pipeline (clinical notes + limited identifiers).
- Primary goals: low-latency inference in production, auditability, and residency controls.
- Preference: Private (VPC/on-prem) if feasible; open to Dedicated if contractual controls are adequate.

High-level Redwood position / options for PHI:
- Hosted API (public SaaS): not acceptable for PHI by default. We do not recommend sending PHI to our hosted multi-tenant endpoints unless explicitly covered by a customer agreement and supported controls.
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity): eligible for PHI processing when covered by a signed BAA and when configured for isolation (networking, encryption at rest, KMS). We will need to validate your residency/region needs and encryption keys.
- Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): preferred option for PHI gives full control over networking, keys, and audit logs; supported for regulated workloads.

Requests / next steps from MedAI:
1) Could you confirm whether the data will be transmitted only (in-flight) or also stored (at-rest) on our side? Any retention windows?
2) Please attach your security questionnaire / PHI scope (if available).
3) We will need to provide our SOC 2 Type II report, sample BAA, and start the vendor security questionnaire. Target timeline: 1-2 weeks for initial screening, then deeper review for Dedicated/Private.

I appreciate you sending over the questionnaire. If it's easier, I can loop in our Security & Legal (cc'd: Rishi) to coordinate.

Thanks I'll start pulling the SOC2 and BAA template and will share those once Legal signs off.

Best,

Thanks for the ping and the context. I'll take point on the vendor security assessment. Initial plan / ask below:

1) Artifacts we need from Sales (Marissa):
   - Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK) please get the latest.
   - Standard BAA template you intend to present (Legal-approved).
   - Any existing diagrams for Dedicated and Private deployment architectures (networking, KMS flow).

2) Quick eligibility guidance (initial):
   - Hosted API: NOT APPROVED for PHI by default. We will not recommend Hosted for production PHI processing.
   - Dedicated: POTENTIALLY APPROVED if: signed BAA in place; customer-managed KMS or approved key-handling; strong network isolation; defined retention controls and audit logging. Verification required by Security Ops.
   - Private (VPC / on-prem): APPROVED for PHI provided the deployment meets our baseline controls (KMS, logging, patching, access controls). This is the preferred path for regulated workloads.

3) Timeline: I will triage the questionnaire within 2 business days, and will aim to provide an initial risk statement and list of open items within 5 business days. Deeper configuration validation for Dedicated (KMS integration, region restrictions) may take 2-3 weeks depending on infra availability.

4) Cost / provisioning notes: Private deployments may have provisioning lead time (1-3 weeks depending on region and capacity) and additional setup engineering fees; I'll coordinate with infra for a precise estimate once we scope requirements.

I'll start by importing the attached questionnaire into our supplier review tracker (SEC-452) and will follow up with a list of required artifacts and any low-level configuration questions for the infra team.
